content: Padiseyobon shubun Esus puduedash tabadaid
Adashic, chonoadtemaid ushë utsin padiseyobo tsusio dapa isedec Esus puduedsho isun, Nëid ushën natemaid icnuc Esusën bëdamenushe queshun isnuequin padiseyobo utsibo tabadquin caimbededpanëdash.
Aden caimbedednubien podo nidte chedo bidisquiaid uano tsadsho isun Esusën:
—¿Chonoadtemaid ushën daicsambocquid bëdamenquiocte ushë nec, quequinda mimbi tantiape? —caquien
abi caimbededquido otacquio tabadcuededpanëdash. Adec aido otacquio tabadcuedednubien podo nidte chedo bidisquiaid dada Esusën bedshun bëdameshun: —Nidec nid —cac bëdambo yec nidpanëdash.
Aden aid nidmeshun abi bëdamenushe quequin caimbededquido caic: —¿Chonoadtemaid ushën nua uëdëshcaidën min baca ampaëdacsho isun badedquio bedtanquin indoenquioda mimbi ictsia? —quepanëdash Esus.
Aden chuisho tantiash adquiobidi otacquio tabadcuededpanëdash.
Adashic, tsusiobon dayunquio tsadsho isash, Chuiquid dapa nec, utsibo quetsiash, quec padiseyobo cho-choec, quequin tantiashun Esusën nadopanëdash:
—Pec cho, cac choshon tsadte bëtinenda. Tsadte mimbi bëtinambien shubu icbon ambi pec cho caid utsi mibi chuiquid tsusio chosho
isun: “Chuiquid dapa choeque. Uano tabadad,” icbon cac icsamboen naombi quiash natiaic uano tsadpec mibi.
Naden nata. Pec cho, cac choash utsiuc tsadbudta. Adsho isun: “Uano mibi tsadeque. Nëmbo, chuiquidbëd tsadec cho,” capec mibi shubu icbon.

Chuiquidbimboecsho ispashuni, quequid Nuquin Papa yacno choacsho adquid ambi namiaid Nuquin Papan icmendac. Nashunquid icboedi Nuquin Papa yacno choacsho chuiquid Nuquin Papan mibi icmendac —quepanëdash Esus abëdta yuedaido caic.
Aden aido chuishumbic abi yuedquid Esus nadpanëdash: —Pemenu, quequin mibëd icquid min utsibo aton na dadpen icquidouidi pec cho cainda. Aido pemiac, mibi pec cho caoaic.
Pemenu, quequin aton na nibëdquido, daicsaidobëdta bëshuaido pec cho cata.
Adquido mibi cuidquin pemetiapimbo iquec. Adquido pemiash, Bëdambo iquebi, mibi quepec. Nuquin Papa yacno nidash puduedsho ambi bëdambo icmiaid mibi iquendac —quepanëdash Esus abi yuedquid caic.
Nuquin Papa yacnoshon pequido
Aden Esusën chuisho tantiash abëdtan pec tsadquid abentsëc: —Nuquin Papa yacno nidshun abëdtambi pec bëdambo iquebi —quepanëdash.
Adoaquien aidi tantiamenuen utsi chiacbimboec Esus nadpanëdash: —Yuednu, quequin nadënquio pec chota, quequin ambi yuedtequid dadpen chuiposh.
Ambi chiacpadën ushë chonoc: ‘Ëmbi chuiboedtedi pec cho quequin chuitanta,’ cac aton yua nidposh.
Adec nidshun chuituidaquien: ‘Nidtiapimbo iquebi,’ queposh abitedi. Abia chuituidaid abentsëc nadposh: ‘Ëmbi sëuëmboed dëdabi nidtiapimbo iquebi,’ queposh.
“Utsibic: ‘Baca bedshun, Bëdamboen nimbanquinda buaneque. Isnu,’ queshun isedtanenquiocquin ambi bedboed nimbameposh.
“Utsibic: ‘Con chido bedombique. Nidenquio iquebi,’ queposh.

“Aden chuisho tantiash nidshun aidon chiacpaden aton yuan icbo chuioaposh. Adsho tantiash nëishun icbon: ‘Ëmbi isedacmaido yacno nidshun, Pec cho, cata. Aton na nibëdquidbëdta daicsaid, bëshuaid chedo chuitan,’ cac aton yua nidposh.
“Nidshun chuitanec aidobëdi choshon, ‘Mimbi chuiboedo bëombi. Aido icnubi abi tabadte iquec,’ queposh yua.
“Adoaquien: ‘Shubu ënëdacno nidshun ëmbi chuibocpadquido isun bëoata ma con shubun tsucus-tsucustsëcquio yec ma adquido tabadpanuna.
Abia ëmbi pec cho caidon ëbëdtambi petiapimbo iquendac,’ queposh icbo —quepanëdash Esus.
Esuspadquio ictequidquio
Adashic, nidsho matses dadpenshun tsibanac abi choacmi bidiadshun isec Esus nadpanëdash:

—Ëbipadquio icnuequid aton papabëduidi icquid iquec ëbipadquio ictiapimbo iquec. Adecbidi, aton titabëduidi icquid iquec ëbipadquio ictiapimbo icoaic. Adecbidi, aton chidobëduidi icquid iquec ëbipadquio ictiapimbo icoaic. Adecbidi aton bacuëbobëduidi icquid iquec ëbipadquio ictiapimbo icoaic. Adecbidi, aton utsibobëduidi icquid iquec ëbipadquio ictiapimbo icoaic.
Unësmane quiash mëyanac dayactiapimbocquid ëbipadquio ictiapimbo icoaindac —quepanëdash Esus.
Aden chiec Esus abi onquec: —¿Shubu uanu, queshun abia shubu uaid isec, Nëidtenquio nanu, queshun aidtedquiobidi bëshun toccashun shubu uainquioda icpec?
Aden tantienquiocquidën abentse-abentsen bë-bëtsëcquin baded naintiapimbo iquec.
Adsho isun utsibon mamënshumpec. Bëdamboen isun shubu uaquidpadquid, Esuspadquio icnu, queshun ëmbi chiaid bëdamboen tantiabenash adquiobidi icpec. Ëbi tantiauidtsëcquid ëbipadquio ictiapimbo iquec.

“Adembi chuinu. Tantiata: ‘Mibëd icquidobëd cuesnanuec chuiquid utsi nëmbo cho-choec,’ quesho tantiashun nëmbobi icquido chuiquidën naden tantiapec: ‘Ëbëd icquido daëdpactsëc iquec. Aidtedtsëqui iquec dayacquiocquid icquin chuiquid utsi abëd icquido cuemepec, queshun ma chobono,’ quequin caimpec.
Padnuen, abëd icquido dayactiapimbo icsho isun chuiquidën: Chuiquid utsi bëquedtanta. Bëquedshun, Mibëdi ictsiabi. Ëbëd icquido chuiquid icta, ëbi chuiquid quiosh, quequin chuita, quequin chuiposh.

Adembidi ëbipadquio icnuequidon bëdamboen tantiata. ¿Ëbi chuiquid Esus nec, quequin ambi chiacpadendambi nabampeba? Ai, adonona, queshun adota. Adoesa, Esuspadquiocquid nebi, quenda —quepanëdash Esus abi tsibananquido chiec.
Sa batapentsëcquiocquid
Aden chiashic Esus nadpanëdash: —Sa batambo iquec. Casecac utsibëd daëdash batambo iquec. ¿Sa batapentsëcquiocquid casecac batamboda icpadic?

Padenquio. Secatequid adquid nendac. Adecbidi Esuspadquio icnu quiash ëbipadquio yanesa chian anëdënquequid nësiatequid nendac. Adquid ictiapimbo iquebi, quequin, Tantianu, queshun tantiacpadomboen nabanta —quepanëdash Esus.
